_meta.purpose: Reproducible A/B for the production-reference gate. Each show carries realistic comments WITH the Reddit thread title they came from. CONTAMINATED cases are off-topic reactions in threads about a same-named novel/film/phrase — the OLD classifier (no thread context) marks them relevant; the NEW gate must drop them. ON-TOPIC cases are real audience reactions in staging threads — both arms must keep them. Used by scripts/ab-reddit-relevance.js --fixture. No live Reddit needed.
